reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it invites viewers to join Forsage, claims that 200,000 people earned 200 crore rupees in five months, and provides a number for details. It recommends taking slots for stated multiples and large rupee returns through tiers and circles, with returns depending on upline, downline, and cross-line participation shown in branching diagrams.

citations.quote: join forsage and earn your dream money call for detail 8115022493.
You should take 12 slots for 3 slot to get 10x in income
your 4 Upline, 4 Downline, 4 Downline, and your 4 Crossline will make you earn x6 as a result of the cross-line
The same person will come here.. You will have 30 % revenue
Then you get a 100 % salary.

opening.argument: The presentation uses conditional, explanatory language rather than a guarantee that every viewer will profit. It says viewers “might get” a stated slot outcome, and describes income as depending on circles being filled and people joining. That uncertainty matters: the material presents a model to consider, not proof that returns are assured. The description also says to “call for detail,” directing viewers toward further discussion rather than claiming that the summary alone establishes a result. The figures should therefore be treated as illustrative projections whose conditions require investigation, not as a deceptive certainty.

citations.quote: you might get an x lot of 10 diversity in a xgold
As soon as you join someone. Then in x3 there will be a gold.
join forsage and earn your dream money call for detail 8115022493.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution highlights large figures and team terminology, but those quotations do not establish that the speaker guaranteed payment or concealed conditions. “You should take” is advice about the presented plan, while “to get 10x” describes the stated target of a slot arrangement. The prosecution also treats “salary” as proof of certainty even though the surrounding explanation discusses circle completion and participation. Nothing in its cited excerpts independently verifies that the claims were presented as unconditional promises.

citations.quote: You should take 12 slots for 3 slot to get 10x in income
Then you get a 100 % salary.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The conditional wording does not neutralize the overall solicitation. The description explicitly invites viewers to join and earn, while the narration assigns concrete multiples and returns to slot purchases. The explanation repeatedly ties income to a recruitment structure, including uplines, downlines, and cross-lines, rather than to an independently described product or service. Calling the figures projections cannot explain why the presentation gives detailed earnings outcomes without showing evidence that those outcomes are reliable.

citations.quote: join forsage and earn your dream money
your 4 Upline, 4 Downline, 4 Downline, and your 4 Crossline will make you earn x6 as a result of the cross-line
You should take 12 slots for 3 slot to get 10x in income

opening.argument: The format is a worked explanation of how the system is organized. The speaker introduces the subject as something the audience is going to discuss, then walks through slot types, circle structures, and how lines interact. The frames show a handwritten presentation headed “Decentralized Forsage.io,” with tier calculations and branching diagrams, which is consistent with a tutorial or demonstration of an operational system. The narration explicitly explains what happens in X3, X4, XXX, and XGold and repeatedly uses examples to show movement through the structure. That instructional presentation does not by itself establish that the video is certifying the plan as safe or guaranteeing the advertised outcomes.

citations.quote: Today we are going to talk about the Triple Action As Gold Plans Of Forcest.io
in x3 there will be a single line where there is a 3 circle in x4 with 2 line where there is a 6 circle
For example, you joined someone.

rebuttal.rebuttal: A tutorial format does not change what is being taught. The explanation is not an abstract lesson about mathematics or software: it tells viewers what to join, what slots to take, and what income they may obtain. The cited diagrams are not neutral evidence of educational purpose; they depict the same income-producing structure described in the narration. Calling the content a demonstration therefore sidesteps its promotional instructions and earnings claims.

citations.quote: You should take 12 slots for 3 slot to get 10x in income
you will get 2x income in X4
join forsage and earn your dream money call for detail 8115022493.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The detailed walkthrough is precisely what makes the content promotional rather than an ordinary technical lesson. The speaker does not merely describe labels: the narration says viewers will receive multiples of income and explains how cross-line, upline, and downline participation produces those returns. The invitation to join and the phone number supply a direct recruitment context. A whiteboard and explanatory tone cannot erase those concrete solicitations.

citations.quote: you will get 2x income in X4
your cross-line will also get you the same amount
call for detail 8115022493.

opening.argument: The supplied material does not show a conventional deposit interface, payment receipt, credential request, or completed transaction. It describes a blockchain-based internet platform and explains named plan configurations, but the evidence does not establish that money was actually collected from a viewer or that anyone was denied a product. The narration says the platform is “totally decentralized” and that it works “on the blockchain,” framing the subject as a digital service whose operation is being explained. The available frames show handwritten labels and diagrams, not a checkout screen or account-transfer instruction. On this record, the judge should avoid inferring a scam mechanism from tier terminology alone.

citations.quote: Forsage.io is a totally decentralized platform and this works on the blockchain and work on the internet
you will get a slot for 3 slot, 4 slot, 4x4, xx3, xxx and xx3

rebuttal.rebuttal: The missing checkout screen is not decisive because the mechanism is described verbally. The video links income to acquiring slots and to the activity of uplines, downlines, and cross-lines. That is more than ordinary service information: it identifies the participation structure through which the advertised returns are supposedly produced. The blockchain description establishes a claimed platform feature, not a product that explains the promised income.

citations.quote: your 4 Upline, 4 Downline, 4 Downline, and your 4 Crossline will make you earn x6 as a result of the cross-line
You should take 12 slots for 3 slot to get 10x in income

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The record does show the relevant mechanism even without a checkout screen: viewers are told to take slots, and income is tied to filling circles and recruiting or benefiting from multiple lines. The service label does not explain why the presentation assigns 10x, 32 lakhs, 48 lakhs, and larger returns to these structures. The absence of a payment interface limits what can be inferred about transaction details, but it does not make the recruitment-based earnings pitch ordinary commerce.
